claim: Under the frozen d=6 cubic ECS and Branch36 width regime, the Branch38 stable weak S3 subspace admits prospectively generated, microscopically realizable nonzero S3 displacements at N in {36,48,72} whose instantaneous function displacement is strongly suppressed relative to equal-S3-norm robust-direction controls on both training and fresh evaluation panels. This establishes a realizable approximate function-preserving S3-changing intervention control under the tested regime.
